_comment: RFC-TM-2 Q3 (rfc-tm-2-diamond.md §3, §4 'Q3 -- Corpus proof + closure'). Quantum-local throwaway manifest -- deleted in the same PR that lands it, per the doc's exact lifecycle wording. Expected-ERROR entries for each of the 141 corpus documents plus the one explicit extra input (naming-edge-cases-example.tmd) that produce at least one ERROR/MISSING node. Every entry below was cross-checked against the LIVE regex parser's own behavior on the same line (parser-patterns.ts / longform-parser.ts, this conversation's empirical tests): each is either a line the live parser silently DROPS (its regex returns null, so the whole line vanishes with no diagnostic) or MANGLES (the live regex matches but captures a garbage/truncated value) -- never a form the live parser handles correctly that the grammar rejects. Files not listed here are expected to parse with ZERO ERROR/MISSING nodes. Six recurring defect classes account for all but two of the manifest lines; each entry names its class.

defect_classes.empty-list: A continuation's bracketed list is empty (`<- []`, `-> []`, `=> []`, `~> []`, `> []`). Every C1/C2/C3/C6/C7/C8/C9/C15 live regex requires `[^\]]+` (one-or-more) inside the brackets and returns null on `[]`; the live parser drops these lines with no diagnostic. `name_list` in the grammar requires >=1 `list_entry` with no `optional`, so `[]` cannot match either.
defect_classes.multiline-bracket-list: A bracketed continuation list wraps onto a second (or third) physical line before its closing `]`. The live parser processes input line-by-line (`this.lines = input.split('\n')`); every list regex is anchored to one line and returns null when `]` is on a later line, so the live parser drops the tail. The grammar's `name_list`/`_line_end` shape is likewise single-line.
defect_classes.array-suffix-bare-name: A bare (non-list) input/output continuation carries a trailing `[]` array-type suffix (`-> TaskResult[]`, `<- Message[]`) or a comma-separated pair of bare names (`<- Task, TaskContext`). `INPUT`/`OUTPUT` are `/^<-\s*(\w+)$/` and `/^->\s*(\w+)$/` -- anchored `$` after one `\w+` run, so both drop on a trailing `[]` or a `, second-name` tail. The grammar's `input_name`/`output_name` are `seq($._indent, sigil, $.entity_name, ..., $._line_end)` with the same single-identifier shape.
defect_classes.classfile-trailing-colon: A ClassFile shortform/sigil declaration's path carries a stray trailing `:` copied from the File-declaration convention (`Name #: path.ts:`). The live `CLASS_FILE` regex's path group is `[^\s<]+` (colon-permissive), so it MANGLES the line -- it parses, but the captured path value is `path.ts:` with the colon baked in. The grammar's `path` token `/[^ \t\n:{}]+/` excludes `:`, so the trailing colon is a dangling token with nothing to attach to and lands in ERROR.
defect_classes.quoted-literal-union-field-type: A DTO field type is a union of quoted string literals (`- theme: "light" | "dark" | "system" "UI theme preference"`). The live `DTO_FIELD` regex's type group is `[^"]+?` (excludes quotes) and the whole regex fails to match at all (verified empirically: returns null), so the live parser drops the entire field line. The grammar's `field_type` token excludes `"` from its character class for the identical reason (so a trailing description string can be split off), producing the same drop as an ERROR-class outcome.
defect_classes.unrecognized-form: A line or block that matches none of the 11 entity-declaration patterns, none of the 15 continuation patterns, and none of the 12 longform headers in the live parser OR the grammar -- confirmed by testing every live top-level/continuation regex against the line and getting null across the board. Includes: `theme {` / `globalStyles {` bare-name block headers (scenario-32, doc-named), `*`-sigil declarations (scenario-46), `Name < "desc"` + `.method(...)` pseudo-interface blocks (scenario-34), `@`-prefixed field names (scenario-36), a multi-line parenthesized function signature's continuation-indented body lines (scenario-56), `123Name`/`$dollar`/`"Name With Spaces"`/kebab-case/Unicode entity names (scenario-54, doc-named for the digit case), and the `fields: [ {...}, ... ]` array-of-objects DTO-fields shape (getting-started-dto-longform, doc-named file for its P7 fixture but not this line).

lib/typed-mind-static-website/snippets/g.reason: `fields: [` opens a multi-line array-of-inline-objects; none of the live longform parser's five per-line property regexes (`array-single-line`, `nested-object-open`, `string`, `bool`, `identifier`) match `fields: [` alone (all return null, verified empirically), so the block plus every array-item line is dropped silently by the live parser. The grammar's `dto_fields_block`/`property_list` productions require `fields: {` (nested block) or a single-line `[a, b]`, neither of which matches this array-of-objects form.

lib/typed-mind-test-suite/scenarios/scen.reason: `<- CreateOrderDTO, AddressDTO` -- comma-separated bare input names

`theme {` (doc-named) and `globalStyles {` (doc-named) bare-name block headers, plus every `KEY: "value"` line inside each block body including each block's final property line (445, 452) -- the outer ERROR node for each block subsumes its interior; interior lines each also produce a nested ERROR since they match no valid top-level production without a recognized declaration sigil.
`-> TaskResult[]` / `-> TaskInfo[]` (doc-named array-suffix-output pattern)
`<- Task, TaskContext` -- comma-separated bare input names (doc-named comma-separated-bare-types pattern)

`PluginAPI < "Plugin API interface"` / `Logger < "Logger interface"` / `FileUtils < "File utilities interface"` / `ProcessUtils < "Process utilities interface"` headers (doc-named `.method()` block forms) plus each `.methodName(args): ReturnType` body line under them -- matches none of the live parser's 11 top-level entity patterns (verified empirically) nor any C1-C15 continuation, so the whole four-block region is dropped by the live parser. Blank lines 475, 481, 488 are NOT flagged.
`-> Post[]` / `-> object[]` (doc-named array-suffix-output pattern)

`Name ! : Type` -- a Constants declaration with an EMPTY path before the optional `: Schema` (e.g. `logoSvg ! : string`). The live `CONSTANTS` regex's path group `[^:]+` MANGLES this: it matches a single literal space as the 'path' rather than failing, so the live parser accepts the line with a garbage whitespace-only path value. The grammar's `path` token `/[^ \t\n:{}]+/` requires >=1 non-space/colon character and cannot match an empty/whitespace-only span, so the grammar rejects outright what the live parser silently mangles.

`- @context: string "Schema context"` / `- @type: string "Schema type"` -- DTO field names prefixed with `@`. The live `DTO_FIELD` regex's name group is `(\w+)`, which does not admit a leading `@`, so the live parser drops both lines; the grammar's `field_name` token `/[A-Za-z_]\w*/` is equally exclusive.
`<- Message[]` -- bare input with array-type suffix

`someConstant * "Constants"` -- `*` is not a recognized sigil in any of the 11 live entity patterns (verified empirically: matches none); the grammar has no `*`-sigil production either. Line 42 (`API_URL: "https://api.example.com"`) is the orphaned continuation-indented line under it -- with no valid parent entity, it matches no C1-C15 continuation pattern (no recognized sigil prefix) either.
`-> [ValidRoot, ..., SelfContainer, ` wraps onto the next physical line before its closing `]`

`<- []` / `-> []` / `=> []` / `~> []` / `> []` across every list sigil -- doc-flagged as a checker-verdict-movement file (empty strings/entities), and its empty LISTS hit the same live-parser silent-drop behavior as every other empty-list occurrence in the corpus.

`  <: BaseClass  # But has inheritance` -- a ClassFile declaration (line 18) followed by a continuation-indented `<:` inheritance line; `<:` inheritance is E4's top-level Class-declaration syntax, not a C1-C15 continuation form, so it matches none of the live parser's 15 continuation patterns (verified empirically) and is silently dropped -- the line's own comment ('But has inheritance') does not reflect what the live parser actually does with it.
`-> [ValidChild, ..., DeepChild, ` wraps onto the next physical line before its closing `]`
`-> [ValidName, ..., PascalCaseName, ` wraps onto two more physical lines before its closing `]`

`kebab-case-name @ src/kebab.ts:` -- a hyphenated entity name at declaration position; the live `FILE` regex's name group is `(\w+)` (no hyphen), so it drops the line the same way the grammar's `entity_name` (`/[A-Za-z_]\w*/`, no hyphen) does.
`123Name @ src/invalid-number.ts:` -- leading-digit name (doc-named S-GRAMMAR-4b disclosed narrowing; the live `\w+` accepts this today, so this is a deliberate narrowing, not a shared drop).
`$dollar @ src/dollar.ts:` -- `$` is outside both the live parser's `\w+` name class and the grammar's `entity_name` class.
`"Name With Spaces" @ src/spaces.ts:` -- a quoted, space-containing name is not an entity_name in either the live parser or the grammar.

`名前 @ src/unicode.ts:` -- a non-ASCII (Unicode) entity name; JavaScript's `\w` is ASCII-only, so the live `FILE` regex's `(\w+)` group fails to match, dropping the line exactly as the grammar's ASCII-only `entity_name` does.

`complexFunc :: (` opens a multi-line parenthesized signature; the live `FUNCTION` regex (`/^(\w+)\s*::\s*(.+)$/`) matches the OPENING line fine (capturing only `(` as the truncated signature, since `.+` cannot span the newline) -- so the top-level declaration itself is NOT an unexpected error -- but every subsequent continuation-indented body line (`param1: { nested: ... },` etc.) matches none of the live parser's 15 continuation patterns and is silently dropped. The grammar's `function_declaration`/`signature` productions share the identical single-line-signature shape and produce the identical per-body-line ERROR outcome.

`-> [` opens a multi-line export list with a per-entry inline `#` comment on each continuation line (`helperFunc,      # OK - Function`); the live `EXPORTS` regex requires the closing `]` on the same line as `->`, so the whole multi-line block is dropped, matching the plain multiline-bracket-list class.

`  @ src/wrongpath.ts:  # Classes can't have paths! This is invalid` -- a deliberately-invalid continuation-position `@ path:` line with no entity name (this scenario's own comment states the intent); matches no C1-C15 continuation pattern in the live parser or the grammar.

`range-version ^ "Range version" ^4.0.0` (doc-named caret-version pattern) and `tilde-version ^ "Tilde version" ~5.0.0` -- npm-style range-prefixed (`^4.0.0` / `~5.0.0`) version strings. The live `DEPENDENCY` regex's version group `v?([\d.\-\w]+)` admits neither a leading `^` nor a leading `~`, so it drops both lines entirely (verified empirically: both return null); the grammar's `version` token `/v?[\d.\-\w]+/` is equally exclusive of both prefixes.
`-> [httpClient, serverSetup, s3Upload, renderUI, ` wraps onto two more physical lines before its closing `]` (doc-named multi-line-bracketed-list pattern).

`-> []  # Explicitly empty exports` -- empty-list with a trailing inline comment; same live-parser drop as every other empty-list occurrence (the `EXPORTS` regex fails before the comment is ever considered).

Listed for completeness; contributes NO error to this file's expected count.
